title: I've Started 75+ Businesses: Here’s What Actually Matters
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast

idea.name: College-town iPhone repair shop
idea.one_liner: Phone repair storefront near a university, learning repairs from YouTube, marketed via custom wristband ads handed out at bars, expanded to 4 locations including a mall kiosk
idea.offer: iPhone screen/battery repair, buyback resale on eBay

key_quotes.quote: And then I read some articles about some LSU students that opened a store fixing iPhones that were doing 30 grand a month.
College students would go to the bar, break their iPhone, get drunk, wake up, broke an iPhone and a wristband with an ad on it.

claims.quote: I Googled custom wristbands. They were 2 cents each.

claims.claim: Grew to four locations and sold
claims.quote: And I called it Phone Restore. We grew to four locations and sold it.

claims.claim: Learned repairs on YouTube while customer waited
claims.quote: We'll figure it out." And they'd walk out and I'd go to YouTube and I'd learn how to fix their iPhone with their iPhone.

acquisition_channels.details: storefront near campus and mall kiosk

ideas.other_uk_rules: WEEE/battery disposal; consumer rights on repairs

stated_problem.quote: Five ingredients only distributed to DFW. And I just thought it was a crime that this bread wasn't sold online.
stated_problem.speaker: Chris Koerner

idea.name: Launch online sales for a local food brand on rev-share
idea.one_liner: Offer an offline local food maker to build and fund their e-commerce channel for a cut of online sales, no upfront cost to them
idea.customer: local food producers without online sales

key_quotes.quote: I'll pay for it. If it works, give me a cut of everything I sell online.

claims.quote: That one became a sevenf figureure business.
It luckily was right before COVID. His sales went crazy.

ideas.other_uk_rules: Food business registration, distance-selling food labelling (FIR)

idea.name: E-commerce food brand fulfillment/3PL
idea.one_liner: Warehouse logistics and fulfillment for e-commerce food brands; grew fast in COVID but low margin and over-concentrated on one client

key_quotes.quote: Basically, you're competing with Amazon. You either need a hundred billion dollars or you need to be the most expensive kind of niche service.

claims.quote: We were making 300 grand a month. Asterisk topline, not profitable.
He was my Sended customer. He accounted for 85% of our revenue.
I had Send Eats, this e-commerce fulfillment brand with a 10,000 square foot warehouse and 32 employees.

idea.name: LCD Cycle (phone parts business)
idea.one_liner: Second business after phone repair, grown fast with mentor capital, revenue $2M, $4.8M, $8.8M in first three years

key_quotes.quote: 2 million the first year, 4.8 the second, 8.8 the third year.

claims.claim: Turned down $1M for 20% VC term sheet
claims.quote: It was a million dollars for 20% equity and it's what I needed to get through this growth phase.

idea.name: Bitcoin mining facility
idea.one_liner: Bought an off-market facility and started bitcoin mining after China's ban, reaching $10M profitably in 3 months

key_quotes.quote: In this business, we went from 0 to$10 million profitably this time in three months.

claims.quote: And in 12 months, it was like 0 to 15 million.

idea.name: RV and mobile home park acquisitions
idea.one_liner: Company acquiring RV and mobile home parks; negotiated a $50M term sheet before partners ousted him

key_quotes.quote: And around the same time, I started a company called Better Exit that started acquiring RV and mobile home parks.

claims.quote: No screenshot this time for a $50 million deal which was hundred times bigger than any other term sheet.

ideas.other_uk_rules: Mobile Homes Act 1983 and site licensing

idea.name: Tree trimming business (owner-operated via subs)
idea.one_liner: Owned tree trimming business where the owner quotes jobs, manages subcontractors and margins in Jobber

key_quotes.quote: For instance, in my we have we own a tree trimming business. I got to know how to quote these jobs.

ideas.other_uk_rules: Tree Preservation Orders/conservation areas; waste carrier licence for green waste
